tasks.title: Add read-only structured diagnostic transport
tasks.objective: Add diagnose_recovery(project,evidence,request_identity,route) as a separate mode using a verified authorized Planner-role route supplied by existing M2/caller role policy. Reuse only diagnostic subprocess transport and authorization mechanics, not diagnosis.* fixed card-advice profile/model defaults. Extend the existing Planner runtime with the constrained no-tools diagnostic invocation and caller-supplied deadline; persist route/authorization provenance as evidence. No fallback from actionable Planner diagnosis to owner-card advice JSON is allowed. Return untrusted JSON bytes plus transport outcome to the M5 adapter, which alone parses recovery-proposal/1. The prompt asks for causal history, integrated-tree check, evidence references, supported actions, ordered prerequisites, expected outcome and falsifiable checks; it offers no owner decision answer and never executes suggested commands. Read full retained evidence by bounded sections; when the bound cannot represent required history, return evidence_incomplete instead of silently truncating. One persisted diagnostic invocation per cycle; timeout, unavailable configuration or invalid JSON leaves an explicit blocker, without retrying the model automatically. Use only prompt evidence and a private output directory; do not inherit a writable project, owner browser or connector session. Probe runtime capabilities before dispatch; if no-tools/MCP denial cannot be enforced, return unsupported_diagnostic_sandbox. Tests attempt a built-in write and MCP write and assert neither tool can be invoked.

tasks.title: Compile and apply constrained recovery revisions through M1
tasks.objective: Implement compile_recovery_revision(plan,evidence,proposal) and apply_recovery_revision(...) at existing Planner/remediation and M1 boundaries. Compiler permits correct_tasks, repair_verification or refresh_integrated_audit only within named owner scopes, inherited requirements and current integration base; it rejects unsupported actions, unknown files/tasks/evidence, cycles, weakened criteria/gates and unsafe command syntax. Corrective implement tasks may author new regression checks in owned paths; new command verification must bind created_by and pass existing Planner/M6 validation, never execute during diagnosis. Generate a fresh integration command-running task after corrections and place both existing independent audit/cross-check scopes after it; add a missing cross-check only where owner policy requires one. M1 adds persisted recovery-authorization/1 with case/proposal/source/target hashes, explicit scoped task grants, one supplementary audit attempt per audit, and unique consumption keys. Recovery-specific rebase preserves every existing budget_base, waits and reworks, prior attempts and unrelated task state; unchanged accepted tasks remain accepted. Extend M1 state schema additively and retain schema-1/2 readers. Ordinary owner rebase retains its current semantics. Do not cancel unrelated live attempts to apply a recovery: wait for quiescence, recheck identities, freeze once, apply via M1, rebind runtime, mark committed. Recover crash windows before/after freeze/rebase by hashes and durable journal, without duplicate revisions, allowances or plan writes. Replace first-command-of-first-owner inference for recovery/remediation tasks with deterministic verification coverage: union all relevant command checks of every affected declared owner, add a symptom regression oracle, and map each owned code/test surface to its necessary checks in recovery-verification-map/1. Web changes inherit web typecheck/build verification in addition to backend checks when applicable. A missing independent oracle blocks compilation. Actual authorized edits that reveal an additional surface require deterministic verification replanning and rerun within the same case before acceptance; no grant, criterion or diagnostic-cycle reset follows replanning. repair_verification is additive only: preserve every frozen acceptance criterion and existing check, adding coverage/oracle or repairing a proven environment prerequisite; deletion/replacement/relaxation requires explicit owner permission. Each new symptom oracle must run red on the captured broken source with only its test overlay, fail for the intended reproduced symptom rather than setup/import/environment error, then run green on the corrected integrated tree through normal independent verification. Nonreproducible or unverifiable red/green provenance blocks closure.

tasks.title: Wire bounded recovery into existing owner and watch lifecycle
tasks.objective: Keep RecoveryAdapter the sole M5 importer. Add tick_diagnostic_recovery, recovery_status and preview_recovery methods returning plain versioned mappings; runtime/watcher call the adapter, not isolated M5. Create a case on exhaustion of ordinary remediation/named rework or two consecutive verified no-progress observations. Precedence: owner stop/hold or owner-only pending decision; stale identity/evidence outage; cycle already consumed; diagnose; validate/prepare; quiescent apply; execute; integration; independent audit/cross-check; assess progress. Existing ordinary remediation remains first path until exhausted unless confirmed unchanged-evidence loop triggers early diagnosis. Proposed policy is one diagnostic cycle per run/audit lineage, persisted across revisions and restarts, at most eight corrective implement tasks and one diagnosis invocation using current configured timeout; corrective tasks retain configured ordinary attempts and each independent audit gets at most one supplemental attempt. On failure or unresolved/regressed/new blocking findings after the cycle, record an exact blocker and escalate without another autonomous cycle. Strategy identity combines action DAG, owner paths, expected outcomes and checks with semantic evidence/source/check digests, not word choice. Never replay a failed identical strategy over unchanged evidence. Expose scheduler-op recovery-preview/recovery-status; preview reads live sources without writes, diagnosis calls or decision answers. Approval authorizes the bounded policy snapshot for newly launched runs automatically; existing runs default to preview except the one explicitly conditionally authorized REQ027 case. Preserve owner-only decisions; no per-failure activation question is added for new runs. Consume automatic technical recovery without answering legacy owner decisions; keep authentic permission/product questions open. Persist per-run activation through enable_diagnostic_recovery(run_identity,preview_digest,stop_generation,authorization_ref): accept a frozen approved policy snapshot or a specific owner control, reject stale preview, missing authorization or active stop; no preview command enables it. Route diagnostic planning through existing Planner-role M2/caller policy and authorization; persist the chosen route evidence and reject absent, stale or unauthorized routing without falling back to card diagnosis defaults.
